content.title: Chapter 42 - FIRE PREVENTION AND PROTECTION — Sec. 42-90. - I.F.C. Section 5806.2, Limitations.
content.summary:
Section 5806.2 Limitations
, is amended to read as follows:
"5806.2. Limitations.
Storage of flammable cryogenic fluids in stationary containers outside of buildings
                  shall conform to the geographic limits established in this code."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
